exercises.question: Which sentence does not identify a specific agent? [¿Cuál no identifica un agente específico?]
options: Se busca una persona con experiencia. [A person with experience is wanted.]
El director busca una persona con experiencia. [The director is looking for a person with experience.]
La directora contrató a una persona ayer. [The director hired a person yesterday.]

exercises.sentence: Se __ una persona con experiencia en gestión. [A person with management experience is wanted.] (buscar)

exercises.english: Professional experience and a good level of English are required.

sentences: Se publica la oferta. [The advert is published.]
Se reciben las solicitudes. [Applications are received.]
Se seleccionan los candidatos. [Candidates are selected.]

options: Se requiere experiencia profesional. [Professional experience is required.]
Se requieren experiencia profesional. [Professional experience are required.]
Se requerir experiencia profesional. [To require professional experience.]

exercises.question: Which means «Working from home is permitted»? [¿Cuál significa «Se permite trabajar desde casa»?]
options: Se permite trabajar desde casa. [Working from home is permitted.]
Se busca trabajar desde casa. [Working from home is wanted.]
Se requiere trabajar desde casa. [Working from home is required.]

exercises.sentence: Se __ reuniones todos los lunes. [Meetings are organised every Monday.] (organizar)

exercises.english: In this company, working from home two days a week is permitted.

exercises.sentence: Se busca una persona con experiencia en gestión de proyectos.
options: A person with project-management experience is wanted.
A person with project-management experience is required.
A person with project-management experience was promoted.

exercises.sentence: Se requiere experiencia profesional y buen nivel de inglés.

options: Se permite trabajar desde casa dos días a la semana. [Working from home two days a week is permitted.]
Se permiten trabajar desde casa dos días a la semana. [Working from home two days a week are permitted.]
Se permites trabajar desde casa dos días a la semana. [You permits working from home.]

exercises.question: Why is «se» useful in «Se busca una persona»? [¿Por qué se usa «se»?]
options: The agent is not specified. [No se especifica quién realiza la acción.]
The speaker is the agent. [El hablante realiza la acción.]
It marks the past tense. [Marca el pasado.]

exercises.sentence: Se __ los candidatos después de la entrevista. [The candidates are selected after the interview.] (seleccionar)
